async def act(page):
    # Click the Settings link to navigate to project settings
    settings_link = page.get_by_role("complementary", name="Project navigation").get_by_role("link", name="Settings")
    await settings_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Now on settings page, find and update the project title field
    # Look for a textbox with name 'Project name' or similar
    title_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Project name")
    if await title_field.count() == 0:
        # Try alternative accessibility-based selector
        title_field = page.get_by_label("Project name")
    if await title_field.count() == 0:
        # Fallback: use get_by_role with generic name or placeholder if accessible
        title_field = page.get_by_role("textbox").filter(has=page.get_by_text("Project name"))
    # Clear the existing value and set new title
    await title_field.fill("")
    await title_field.fill("Welcome to my site")
    # Find and click the save button
    save_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save changes")
    if await save_button.count() == 0:
        save_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save")
    await save_button.click()
    # Wait for save to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
